title: GitHub profile README blueprint
description: Single source of truth for generating the GitHub profile README.md. Each section points at an HTML fragment under the repo; titles become ## headings when non-empty. CSS is local-preview only and is never written into README.md.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

sections.description: Ordered sections composed into README.md and the local preview.

title.description: Section heading. Empty string means no ## heading is emitted.

content.description: Path to an HTML fragment relative to the repository root (for example src/about.html).
